<thought>The mass spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope: a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with intensities matching the binomial distribution for ~10 carbons (100 : ~11 : ~0.5 : ~0.016 : ...). No other distinctive isotopic patterns (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are present. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
